description: This file defines the 'taskRunner' struct and its methods for executing functions asynchronously, capturing errors via channels, and synchronization using wait groups and mutexes.

classes.name: taskRunner
classes.description: A struct for managing the execution of asynchronous tasks with error handling and synchronization.

methods.name: ExecuteFunctionsAsync
methods.description: Executes a list of functions asynchronously and returns an error if any function fails.

methods.name: breakOnError
methods.description: Blocks until an error is sent on the error channel.

methods.name: syncErrorFnToAsync
methods.description: Wraps functions to redirect errors to the error channel.

methods.name: closeErrorChanOnComplete
methods.description: Closes the error channel after all tasks are completed.

methods.name: spawnTasksAsync
methods.description: Starts each function in the provided list as a separate goroutine.

methods.name: redirectErrToChannel
methods.description: Wraps a function to capture its error and send it to the error channel.
